description: A second, independent unit of work spawns a new child instead of continuing the first. This is the negative control: a rule that always resumes would fail it.

turns.prompt: Use the `subagent` tool. Do not do this yourself and do not ask questions. Spawn the `spectre` agent with description "Write a" and this task: "Create /workspace/a.txt with exactly the word alpha." Do not call `tools.spectre.routing`. Let the child inherit your model. When it returns, report its `sessionID`.

This is a new unit of work, not a correction. Spawn a new child with description "Write b" and this task: "Create /workspace/b.txt with exactly the word beta." Do not pass the first child's `sessionID`. Do not call `tools.spectre.routing`; let the child inherit your model. Report the new child's `sessionID`.

input.prompt: Create /workspace/a.txt with exactly the word alpha.
Create /workspace/b.txt with exactly the word beta.
